newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 3-yr yields close up on lack of buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 3-yr yields close up on lack of buying.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed higher on Thursday in lacklustre trading on the back of weak buying interest, traders said.
Expectation that profit-taking would emerge soon also fuelled the rise, they said.
Three-month CDs ended flat, while overnight call rates edged up.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.02 pct vs Wednesday's 11.95 pct
* Average overnight call rate end at 11.6 pct vs 11.5 pct
